originalTitle: U2 - The Greatest Show On Earth
content: Official Video for U2’s brand new single “The Greatest Show On Earth” off of their forthcoming 16th studio album “Carnaval De Luz”, out November 13th. Pre-order: https://u2.lnk.to/CarnavalDeLuz Listen to “The Greatest Show On Earth” : http://u2.lnk.to/TheGreatestShowOnEarth Subscribe to the U2 Channel: https://U2.lnk.to/YTSubscribeID Watch More U2 Videos: https://U2.lnk.to/WatchMoreID Sign Up to the U2 Mailing List: https://U2.lnk.to/MailingListID Become a U2.com Member: https://www.u2.com/subscribe Follow U2 on Socials: Instagram: https://U2.lnk.to/InstagramID Facebook: https://U2.lnk.to/FacebookID TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@u2 Twitter: https://U2.lnk.to/TwitterID Official Website: https://U2.lnk.to/WebsiteID Lyrics: If I couldn’t sing How love’s the hardest easy thing And if I couldn’t sing you my life Hiding here in the spotlight And if you couldn’t hear me If I couldn’t feel If I couldn’t feel your touch again When nerve ends fray And there’s nothing to say Not even a prayer It’s a beautiful night somewhere Ohhh ohhh If I couldn’t say it now Tell me how If this is love and love is all we’ve got You can show me what it is I can show you what it’s not If this is love don’t act surprised when you get hurt Even if our dreams lay in the dirt We were once the greatest show on earth Is that a smile or a tear? Is it all show business here? The cinema that is stained glass You’re at the altar at our wedding mass Is this a church of love or fear? Have we made God feel like a stranger here? Ohhh ohhh Say it now Tell me how If this is love and love is all we’ve got You can show me what it is I can show you what it’s not If this is love, we make cathedrals of our hurt People digging their dreams out of the dirt We were once the greatest show on earth Love is a business that works at night I sold myself for less than was right You taught me what I was worth In the greatest show on earth Made a profession out of breaking your heart You call it lies, I call it art I was some of your best work We were once the greatest show on earth Love is a business you shouldn’t trust Breathe on me and I’m love and I’m lust Forever or a flirt? The greatest show on earth The light scatters things can get worse These dark matters of the universe Could not compete with us We were once the greatest show on earth Credits: Merman Director - Anton Corbijn Managing Partner /Executive Producer- Spencer Dodd & Siobhan Murphy Producer - Megan Gutman Production Supervisor - Samantha Clements Production Coordinator - Daniel Brink 1st AD - Sean Tippins Cinematographer - Phedon Papamichael Production Designer - Pele Kudren Makeup Artist (Non Hero Talent) - Joanna Klein Location Scout - Josh Hughes Square Peg Edit Editor - James Rose Edit Producer - Toby Abbott Company Three Colourist - Yoomin Lee Post Producer - Ellora Sorret #U2 #TheGreatestShowOnEarth #CarnavalDeLuz
